abstraction_design.rationale: The shared pieces (card list, species mapping, moves body) are designed around the app's actual variation and stretch well; a little noise (mapAll alias, the overloaded CardData.id) and the index-based extra callback are the only copy/flag creep.

findings.issue: CardData.id is used both for the dex number and for the sprite URL, but it is populated from the Pokémon ref id in speciesForPokemon (api.ts:231) and from the species id in getDex (api.ts:257); a sprite bug for species whose default Pokémon differs would need edits in the component plus both data assembly points.
findings.suggestion: Carry an explicit sprite source (default Pokémon front_default URL, or a defaultPokemonId) in CardData so the two concerns can't silently diverge.

findings.issue: The English display-name rule is re-implemented inline four times in the router while an englishName helper already exists in api.ts:160 — a change to the naming rule lands in two places.
findings.suggestion: Use englishName(species/move/ability/type) from api.ts for the docTitle in all four handlers.

findings.issue: CardList's extra callback receives (p, i) but callers discard p and close over their arrays by index (home.tsx:69-78, details.tsx:78), re-coupling page state to the component's iteration order.
findings.suggestion: Make the item type generic (CardList<T extends CardData>) or move per-card extras into the data, so the callback uses the passed item.

findings.issue: The /pokemon/:name/moves URL with its ?game= parameter is constructed twice in this handler and a third time in pokemon.tsx:170 (hx-get); renaming the route or query param means syncing three strings.
findings.suggestion: Extract a movesUrl(speciesName, game) helper (next to homeUrl in the pages module) and use it everywhere.

findings.issue: mapAll is a one-line alias of Promise.all whose comment implies it applies concurrency limiting it doesn't itself implement — misleading indirection.
findings.suggestion: Delete mapAll and call Promise.all directly, or move the semaphore into mapAll so the comment is true.

findings.issue: The Vary: HX-Request header is set in both the htmx and non-htmx branches of the '/' handler.
findings.suggestion: Set it once before the isHtmx branch.

summary: This is a well-layered app: a single-file data module, small shared UI components, and page modules that all consume the same seams, so most changes concentrate in one or two obvious places. The main editability risks are the overloaded CardData.id (dex number vs sprite source) and a spec rule (English names) duplicated between the router and the data layer's helper. Nothing is entangled; the failures are duplicated-knowledge smells, not structural ones.
